description: Build the 4 setup screens (Onboarding, Planet Selection, Crew Selection, Base Configuration) as real, functional screens using the FEAT-001 components + design tokens, reading/writing the store via useMissionControl and navigating with react-router useNavigate. Wire them into the router with EAGER imports (lazy loading is FEAT-005). The /mission route stays a placeholder until FEAT-004; /debrief stays the existing screen until FEAT-005 re-skins it. Add screen unit tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (components/tokens). Build + all tests pass.
steps: src/features/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx (route '/'): AppShell + ScreenTransition. ASTRA title in Space Grotesk, tagline 'Explore. Decide. Survive. Learn.', a 2-3 sentence kid-friendly 'you are a mission commander' intro, a single 'Begin Mission' PrimaryButton (variant primary, size lg) -> useNavigate('/select-planet'). CSS starfield from AppShell. Inviting and premium; no Skip.

src/features/planet-selection/PlanetSelectionScreen.tsx (route '/select-planet'): two large interactive cards Moon + Mars. Each shows facts from MOON_PROFILE/MARS_PROFILE: gravity (gravity_m_s2), temperature range (temperatureRange.min/max), atmosphere note (Moon: no atmosphere; Mars: thin CO2), day length (timeUnitLabel), radiation (unshieldedDailyRadiation_mSv). Phosphor icons (e.g. Moon, Planet). onClick calls selectPlanet(id); selected card gets accent glow + aria-pressed. 'Continue' PrimaryButton disabled until selectedPlanetId !== null -> /select-crew. 'Back' -> '/'. Read planet via useMissionControl().selectedPlanetId; call selectPlanet via useMissionStore or the hook's store (use useMissionStore action selectPlanet).

src/features/crew-selection/CrewSelectionScreen.tsx (route '/select-crew'): crew-size stepper 1-8 with large +/- buttons; show crew portraits as Phosphor astronaut icons scaling with count. LIVE projected daily consumption readout using life-support-constants: OXYGEN_PER_PERSON_PER_DAY_KG*crew, WATER_PER_PERSON_PER_DAY_KG*crew, FOOD_PER_PERSON_PER_DAY_KG*crew, POWER_PER_CREW_MEMBER_KW*crew as StatReadouts (units kg/day and kW). setCrewSize(n) on change (from useMissionStore). 'Continue' disabled until crewSize >= 1 -> /configure-base. 'Back' -> /select-planet. Clamp 1..8.

src/features/base-configuration/BaseConfigurationScreen.tsx (route '/configure-base'): controls seeded from getDefaultBaseConfig(crewSize) (read crewSize from store; if 0 default to 4 for the preview). Controls: solarPanelArea_m2 slider 0-200, batteryCapacity_kWh slider 0-500, agricultureArea_m2 slider 0-50, shieldingLevel segmented (low/medium/high), lifeSupportEfficiency slider 0.5-1.0. Each has a kid-friendly label + micro-copy + a tradeoff hint (e.g. more solar = more power but more dust exposure). Local state holds the draft BaseConfig. 'Start Mission' PrimaryButton: validate planet+crew present (else inline message), then setBaseConfig(draft) + initializeMission() + useNavigate('/mission'). 'Back' -> /select-crew.

src/app/router.tsx: replace the 4 PlaceholderScreen routes ('/','/select-planet','/select-crew','/configure-base') with the real screens using EAGER imports, each wrapped in <ScreenTransition routeKey={path}>. Keep RequireSetup on /configure-base. Leave /mission as the existing PlaceholderScreen (FEAT-004 replaces it) and /debrief as MissionDebriefScreen (FEAT-005 re-skins it). Guards unchanged.

Screen tests under tests/unit/features/ (MemoryRouter + real store reset between tests): OnboardingScreen (Begin Mission navigates to /select-planet); PlanetSelectionScreen (clicking a card calls selectPlanet and highlights it; Continue disabled until selected then navigates to /select-crew); CrewSelectionScreen (stepper changes crewSize and the projected readout updates; Continue disabled at 0); BaseConfigurationScreen (Start Mission calls setBaseConfig + initializeMission + navigates to /mission; shows validation when planet/crew missing).
acceptance_criteria: All 4 setup screens exist, are functional, use AppShell + ScreenTransition + the FEAT-001 components, read/write the store via useMissionControl/useMissionStore, and navigate correctly

PlanetSelectionScreen displays real facts from the validated profiles; CrewSelectionScreen's readout uses the real life-support-constants rates; BaseConfigurationScreen seeds from getDefaultBaseConfig
Continue/Start buttons are disabled until their precondition is met; Back navigation works
router.tsx renders the 4 real screens on their routes with guards intact; /mission remains a placeholder; /debrief unchanged
Screen unit tests pass; all existing tests remain green
verification: npm run build exits 0 with zero TS errors
npm run test -- --run passes (existing + new setup-screen tests)
